method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: TRADING DAY War on, risk-off: Stocks drop, crude jumps as Trump calls Iran peace deal 'over'
Equities.reason: Clear risk-off market regime from renewed US-Iran tensions and oil spike; broad negative impulse for equities and risk assets.

Equities.title: Stocks Bounce as Oil Caps Mideast-Driven Gains: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Shows dip-buying and market resiliency after geopolitically-driven selloff — limited positive short-term tone versus the larger risk-off backdrop.

Equities.title: Asian shares climb on chip rally, oil jumps as Gulf hostilities resume
Equities.reason: Mixed signal: chip-led gains support regional equities but Gulf hostilities and higher oil tilt the net market impulse toward risk-off.

Equities.title: Stocks Fall as US-Iran Jitters Spur Rally in Oil: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Direct linkage between geopolitical escalation, oil rally and equity selloff — meaningful negative for broad risk sentiment.

Equities.title: Equities: Stagflation hit and chip-sector divergence – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists report that United States (US) equities weakened under a stagflationary backdrop. The S&P 500 fell with broad-based losses, while the Philly semiconductor index outperformed strongly.
Equities.reason: Macro stagflationary concern is negative for broad equities, while chip outperformance signals a narrow leadership — net negative for market breadth.

Equities.title: BlackRock’s Jewell Sees AI Capex Stable for Two to Three Years
Equities.reason: Affirms durable AI investment cycle supporting tech / AI leaders — positive for sector leadership and risk appetite for growth names.

Equities.title: SK Hynix US listing more than seven times oversubscribed, source says
Equities.reason: Strong demand for a large chip listing underscores investor appetite for semiconductors/AI exposure — positive for chip leadership but limited breadth impact.

Equities.title: Samsung, SK Hynix and Leveraged ETFs Drive 70% of Korea Trading
Equities.reason: Concentration of trading into a few chip names and leveraged ETFs raises breadth and liquidity risk — negative for market stability despite chip leadership.

Equities.title: U.S. begins new Iran strikes after closing bell on Wall Street
Equities.reason: Further military action after the close amplifies risk-off and uncertainty for markets — significant negative shock to sentiment and trading risk.

Equities.title: Morning Bid: Chip euphoria vies with war weariness
Equities.reason: Summarises the two competing narratives — narrow-tech euphoria versus broader geopolitical risk; marginally negative for broad indices.

Equities.title: Asian investors eye firms benefiting from but resilient to AI
Equities.reason: Regional demand for AI-resilient names supports the theme of AI-driven leadership in equities — positive but regionally focused and narrow.

Equities.title: US Stocks Pare Iran War-Driven Losses After Dip Buyers Emerge
Equities.reason: Evidence of dip-buying and resilience suggests limited-duration selloffs; offers a moderating bullish counterpoint to the geopolitical shock.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Supported by higher yields and FOMC stance – MUFG
Rates.summary: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan reports that June Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) minutes show policymakers increasingly concerned that US inflation could stay elevated, with some seeing a case for a rate hike.
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes signalling persistent inflation concern and discussion of a possible hike implies higher US yields / tighter Fed path — negative for bond prices and important for global rates.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Constructive outlook as Oil risks build – OCBC
Rates.summary: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note renewed Middle East tensions and higher Oil prices are lifting the US Dollar (USD) and global bond yields.
Rates.reason: Geopolitical-driven oil upside feeding through to higher global yields; reinforces hawkish rate expectations and is bond-negative.

Rates.title: Fed policymakers' inflation worries weighed on rate cut outlook at Warsh's first meeting
Rates.reason: Title implies Fed inflation concerns are reducing the chance of rate cuts — shifts expectations toward higher-for-longer rates and higher yields, negative for bonds.

Rates.title: Japan benchmark bond yield hits 30-year high on inflation, fiscal health concerns
Rates.reason: Direct move higher in JGB yields to multi-decade highs driven by inflation/fiscal concerns — large bond selloff domestically with spillovers to global rates; strongly negative for bond markets.

Rates.title: Investors get inflation 'wake-up call' as Trump fires up oil prices
Rates.reason: Headline frames higher oil as rekindling inflation concerns — raises rate expectations and global yields, negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Live markets: Bitcoin drops to $62,000 as oil and bond yields surge on collapse of Iran ceasefire
Rates.reason: Reports a surge in bond yields linked to geopolitical shock (Iran ceasefire collapse / oil), reinforcing short-term upward pressure on global yields — negative for rates.

Rates.title: Japan’s Five-Year Bond Sale Sees Decent Demand on Higher Yields
Rates.reason: Auction dynamics show higher offered yields but still decent demand — signals higher yield regime in Japan while not a market break; moderately negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: High Yields Set Stage for More Global Bond Inflow Into Indonesia
Rates.reason: Higher global yields are driving cross-border flows into higher-yielding EM bonds (Indonesia) — reflects persistent higher-yield environment (bond-negative for developed markets, positive for EM allocation).

Rates.title: Euro: ECB hawkish repricing with bond selloff – Deutsche Bank
Rates.summary: Deutsche Bank Research’s Early Morning Reid notes that European assets are sensitive to the renewed energy shock. Market pricing for ECB hikes by December rose sharply, implying a chance of three hikes this year after June’s move.
Rates.reason: Deutsche Bank highlights ECB hawkish repricing and bond selloff — stronger expectations of further ECB tightening push European yields up, negative for bond markets.

Rates.title: China's producer inflation hits near 4-year high in June, squeezing manufacturers
Rates.reason: Rising PPI in China points to input-cost inflation which can feed through to global inflation and rate expectations — modestly negative for global bond prices.

Rates.title: BOK’s Shin Sees Need for Rate Hike Ahead of Next Week’s Meeting
Rates.reason: Bank of Korea official signalling a near-term hike tightens regional rate expectations and contributes to higher Asian yields — negative for bond prices regionally.

Rates.title: Bank of Japan may speed up rate hikes, pushing borrowing costs above 2%, ex-BOJ official warns
Rates.reason: Risk that BOJ accelerates normalization and lifts JGB yields above 2% would be a meaningful global rate shock — negative for bond markets and consistent with the hawkish global narrative.

FX.title: US Dollar Index: Fed hawks supported by energy spike – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner notes that higher Oil prices and Gulf tensions have driven a bigger reaction in rates than in FX, with Brent near $80 supporting Fed hawks. The US Dollar (USD) is expected to stay firm versus low-yielders, while carry trades in Emerging Mark
FX.reason: Direct DXY/USD narrative: higher oil and Gulf tensions feeding Fed hawks -> US yields/FX support. High relevance because it frames broad USD strength via rate outlook and commodity/geopolitical drivers.

FX.title: Euro: Early gains against US Dollar at risk on Fed story – ING
FX.summary: Chris Turner at ING highlights that EUR/USD has held up despite higher Oil, as Euro swap rates outperformed US rates on expectations of an ECB hike in September. However, he argues the Fed narrative will dominate, with EUR/USD likely to surrender gains and fal
FX.reason: EUR/USD explicitly framed as vulnerable to the Fed narrative (USD strength). Important cross-currency view but centered on USD/ECB dynamics, so medium-high relevance.

FX.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Dollar bulls lose steam after rejection at 0.8100
FX.summary: The US Dollar is trading lower against the Swiss Franc (CHF) on Thursday, as investors ponder the consequences of reciprocal US and Iran attacks and a 10% rebound in Oil prices, on the major central banks' monetary policies.
FX.reason: Pair-specific technical/flow note: CHF strength vs USD after geopolitical shocks and oil move. Technical/price-forecast format limits relevance (keeps relevance low).

FX.title: Euro: Hawkish Fed keeps gains contained against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Thu Lan Nguyen at Commerzbank notes that EUR/USD has traded in a narrow range and appears largely unaffected by Iran-related headlines, as the correlation with Oil has weakened.
FX.reason: Reinforces broad USD-dominant narrative: hawkish Fed containing EUR gains. Market-relevant but more of a short-term containment view, so medium relevance.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index Price Forecast: Flirts with 23.6% Fibo./weekly low below 101.00
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, extends the previous day's pullback from the 101.25-101.30 region and attracts some follow-through sellers on Thursday.
FX.reason: DXY technical note showing follow-through sellers -> short-term USD weakness. Technical format limits relevance, but still signals USD pullback.

FX.title: Japanese Yen gains against US Dollar despite renewed geopolitical risks
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades higher against the US Dollar (USD) despite renewed geopolitical risks.
FX.reason: JPY strength vs USD despite regional risks is notable given recent weakness and intervention talk — represents a tangible counter-move and is market-relevant for USD/JPY flows.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Euro wavers around 1.1430 with the bearish trend intact
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) posts moderate gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, hitting session highs near 1.1440, yet trapped within the weekly range, with the broader bearish trend in play.
FX.reason: EUR/USD technical/price-forecast piece showing limited upside within a broader bearish trend. Price-forecast format -> capped relevance.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar advances above 0.5700 on RBNZ hawkish stance
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair gains momentum to around 0.5735 during the early European session on Thursday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) on a hawkish interest rate hike from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ).
FX.reason: Central-bank-driven FX move: a unanimous RBNZ hike materially lifts NZD vs USD. High relevance because it represents a rate-driven currency re-pricing and local tightening surprise.

FX.title: Australian Dollar steadies above 0.6900 as markets price a negotiated end to Iran’s war
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) keeps trading sideways against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, showing a surprising resilience to the escalating tensions in Iran.
FX.reason: AUD resilience despite Iran tensions suggests risk/re-pricing assumptions; medium-low relevance as it's more of a market tone note than a structural change.

FX.title: Japanese Yen remains pressured close to 40-year lows as intervention risks linger
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) remains locked in a high-stakes standoff against the US Dollar, testing the ultimate limits of Tokyo’s tolerance for its local currency to depreciate.
FX.reason: Major USD/JPY regime signal: JPY near multi-decade lows with active intervention risk is a high-relevance structural FX story supporting USD strength (and policy/intervention tail risk).

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Hovers above 1.4150 as bullish bias prevails
FX.summary: USD/CAD moves sideways after two days of losses, trading around 1.4170 during the European hours on Thursday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the pair is remaining within the ascending channel pattern, indicating a persistent bullish bias.
FX.reason: USD/ CAD technical note indicating continued USD bullish bias — relevant to commodity-linked CAD flows but presented as price-forecast (caps relevance).

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Downside bias but mixed outlook – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes USD/JPY retains an upside bias, with scope for a test of 162.80 intraday while major resistance at 163.00 is unlikely to be reached. Over 1–3 weeks, the outlook is mixed, with trading expected between 160.60 an

FX.title: Taiwan Dollar Hits 14-Month Low on Greenback Gains, Dividends
FX.reason: EMFX example of broad Greenback strength: TWD weakness cited as driven by USD gains and dividend flows — supports a cross-market USD-strong narrative with medium relevance.

FX.title: WSJ Dollar Index Rises 0.15% to 97.40
FX.reason: Headline DXY move confirming modest USD strength. Short/dated market-move headline -> moderate relevance as a reinforcing data point.

Commodities.title: Gold clings to gains on weaker USD; bearish bias remains amid Iran risks, Fed hike bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its bid tone above the $4,100 mark through the first half of the European session on Thursday and looks to build on the previous day's bounce from a one-week low.
Commodities.reason: Precious metals: mixed drivers. Weaker USD and Iran-related risk support gold, but lingering Fed hike expectations cap upside. Modest short-term bullish impulse with medium-low relevance (metal-specific, not broad commodities shock).

Commodities.title: Oil: Rising geopolitical risks and Russian diesel ban – ING
Commodities.summary: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil has extended its rally as renewed US-Iran tensions threaten the fragile ceasefire and disrupt flows through the Strait of Hormuz.
Commodities.reason: Strong bullish oil narrative. Geopolitical escalation (Hormuz) plus supply-side action (Russian diesel ban) materially tightens markets and reinforces an oil risk premium; high relevance for energy complex and refined products.

Commodities.title: Goldman Says Hormuz Flare-Up May Delay Recovery in Oil Supplies
Commodities.reason: Major sell-side view reinforcing supply disruption narrative. Goldman flagging delayed recovery in supplies amplifies bullish pressure on crude and refined products; high relevance given firm's market influence.

Commodities.title: U.S. exports of crude oil and petroleum products reached record in April
Commodities.summary: U.S. petroleum exports reached a record in April as disruptions to international crude oil and refined product flows through the Strait of Hormuz increased global demand for U.S. exports. Exports increased to 13.6 million barrels per day (b/d) in April, 15% mo
Commodities.reason: Fundamental flows: record U.S. exports indicate re-routing of global supplies amid Hormuz disruptions, supporting tighter physical markets and higher prices for crude/refined products; solid relevance to energy complex.

Commodities.summary: U.S. operable atmospheric distillation capacity, the primary measure of refinery capacity, totaled 18.2 million barrels per calendar day (b/cd) on January 1, 2026-down over 250,000 b/cd (about 1%) compared with January 1, 2025-according to our latest annual Re
Commodities.reason: Structural supply-side constraint for refined products. Declining refinery capacity tightens gasoline/diesel markets, increasing sensitivity to crude disruptions; relevant but more gradual than immediate geopolitics.

Commodities.title: Oil Prices Rise Further After Another Round of Strikes in the Gulf
Commodities.reason: Newsflow-driven upside. Continued strikes in the Gulf sustain an elevated oil risk premium and immediate price support; mainstream coverage amplifies market attention and volatility risk.

Commodities.title: Oil prices ease after spiking following fresh U.S. strikes against Iran
Commodities.summary: Oil prices turned lower on Thursday after the U.S. carried out fresh strikes on Iran, renewing concerns about supply disruptions in the Middle East.
Commodities.reason: Near-term retracement. Intraday profit-taking or technical pullback after an initial spike; provides a modest counter-signal but doesn't negate the broader supply-risk-driven bullish regime.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD jumps to near $59 as US Dollar declines
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up over 1% to near $59.00 during the European trading session on Thursday. The white metal gains as the US Dollar (USD) faces selling pressure despite multiple tailwinds.
Commodities.reason: Silver benefits from weaker USD and safe-haven/geopolitical flows alongside industrial demand; positive but lower relevance than energy geopolitics.

Commodities.title: Xtract Resources begins production at Zambian copper project
Commodities.reason: Supply-side addition for copper. Start of production is a modest bearish signal for copper prices, but likely limited in scale and lower relevance versus major macro/geopolitical drivers affecting broader commodities.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's inflation quagmire gets stickier as renewed MidEast conflict sends oil price soaring
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical escalation lifts oil and inflation risk, driving risk-off flows that pressure crypto prices and reduce risk appetite for BTC/ETH.

Crypto.title: Live markets: Bitcoin ETFs slip back to outflows while ether funds extend their streak
Crypto.reason: Institutional flow signal: renewed BTC ETF outflows are a near-term negative for crypto market liquidity and price momentum despite continued ETH fund inflows.

Crypto.title: U.S. SEC to propose crypto rule as soon as this month to ease startups, fundraising
Crypto.reason: Material regulatory easing signal from a major regulator that could lower barriers for fundraising and innovation—positive for long-term institutional participation and sector growth.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's dwindling exchange reserves don't pack the same bullish punch anymore
Crypto.reason: A commonly-cited bullish on-chain indicator is losing predictive power, reducing a structural bullish narrative for BTC—minor negative for sentiment/technical drivers.

Crypto.title: SpaceX's first bitcoin wallet movements in six months likely don't signal sales

Crypto.title: Crypto and stocks tumble after Trump declares ceasefire 'over' following Iran strikes
Crypto.reason: Immediate risk-off triggered by geopolitical escalation hits crypto alongside equities; meaningful short-term liquidity withdrawal and price downside for risk assets.

Crypto.title: Reserve Bank of India still favors crypto prohibition to curtail tax evasion: Reuters
Crypto.reason: A major economy's central bank publicly favoring prohibition is a significant regulatory headwind that threatens adoption and capital inflows—material negative for the sector.
